title: Director of Engineering and Manufacturing Operations
text:
The **Director of Engineering and Manufacturing Operations** will lead process engineering and production operations for advanced EUV photoresist materials. This role combines technical leadership in process development, scale-up, and manufacturing excellence with responsibility for building the people, systems, and operating capabilities needed to support Inpria’s long-term growth.

The Director leads the Process Engineering Manager and the HVM Operations organization, integrating engineering priorities, manufacturing performance, and organizational capability. The role manages engineering and operations expenditure and execution in support of company objectives, and reports to the VP of Engineering.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Technical and Strategic Leadership**

* Set direction for process engineering and manufacturing operations, aligning objectives and priorities with company objectives cascaded by VP of Engineering, in partnership with senior management and JSR stakeholders.
* Partner with the Director of NPI Engineering to coordinate process development and scale-up, and lead manufacturing readiness and HVM’s participation in product transfers, including to external sites.
* Align engineering and manufacturing to support long-term growth, capacity expansion, and product roadmap needs.
* Lead capital planning and manufacturing capacity expansion in partnership with Facilities, Equipment Engineering, and Maintenance, defining manufacturing requirements and coordinating execution of approved investments.
* Manage operating expenditure (OPEX) and capital expenditure (CAPEX) for engineering and operations, including forecasts, resource allocation, cost control, and performance reporting within approved budgets and delegated authority. Develop plans and investment proposals to support VP in securing departmental budgets.
* Serve as a key interface with customers, supporting qualifications, audits, and long-term partnerships.
* Set priorities for the Process Engineering Manager, who leads the engineering team and owns process design, technical problem-solving, qualification, controlled process documentation, and technical readiness for transfer.
* Work with customer teams to balance production priorities against plant capacity, maintenance activities, equipment installs, and workforce readiness.
* Resolve significant technical, operational, customer-related, and cross-functional priority or resource conflicts within delegated authority; escalate decisions requiring additional approval to VP of Engineering.
* Lead organizational planning and develop the Process Engineering Manager, shift supervisors, and operations personnel to build leadership capability, technical depth, and operational continuity.
* Align technical programs across R&D, manufacturing, quality, and operations to support business goals.
* Ensure process control, equipment strategy, and continuous improvement efforts are properly resourced and executed.
* Support ERP and MES implementation by facilitating manufacturing requirements and ensuring organizational adoption.
* Partner with senior leadership on capacity planning, capability growth, and long-range roadmap execution.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Provide hands-on leadership of the extended-shift HVM operation producing high-purity EUV metal oxide photoresist materials, building a detailed understanding of Inpria’s manufacturing constraints while balancing production requirements with safe, reliable, and effective use of personnel and equipment.
* Lead Operations through shift supervisors and the Manufacturing Engineering Specialist.
* Lead integrated staffing and headcount planning for engineering and operations, ensuring appropriate shift coverage, technical capability, and organizational readiness within approved budgets and headcount plans.
* Ensure manufacturing performance meets production, safety, quality, purity, and contamination-control requirements.
* Establish shared engineering-to-operations transfer criteria. Ensure Process Engineering establishes technical readiness and controlled documentation, and Operations confirms staffing, training, and operating readiness before accepting sustained ownership, with required Quality and EHS approvals.
* Establish and enforce operational discipline through KPIs, standard work, performance management, and continuous-improvement systems.
* Manage the implementation of effective training, operator qualification, accountability, and workforce development systems.
* Build and develop the Operations management team, including defining the scope and hiring plan for an Operations Manager; developing supervisors to lead their shift teams; and developing the Manufacturing Engineering Specialist to coordinate manufacturing readiness, documentation, and floor support. Set team priorities aligned with company objectives and customer satisfaction goals.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressively responsible experience, including roles in engineering or operations management. Experience in high-purity chemicals or semiconductor materials.
* Demonstrated experience managing engineering or manufacturing operating budgets and capital investment plans, including forecasting, resource allocation, cost management, and performance reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to connect technical priorities with safe, reliable manufacturing performance and make sound technical and operational trade-offs in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in contamination control, ultra-high-purity systems, and specialty chemical processing.
* Experience scaling processes from development through full production.
* Proven leadership developing managers, supervisors, or technical teams, with experience supporting a continuous or extended-shift manufacturing environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Familiarity with semiconductor fab customer requirements and qualification processes.
* Experience with photoresist precursors, EUV photoresists, advanced lithography materials, electronics materials, or semiconductor process integration.
* Experience building or scaling manufacturing operations in a growth-stage environment.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to wear standard cleanroom attire in areas that require i
* Ability to wear standard PPE in areas that require it.
* Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time.
* Ability to use a keyboard and mouse for computer data entry, analysis, and presenting data.
* Job is performed on-site.
* Domestic and International travel estimated <20%.
* Occasional nights or weekends may be required due to meetings and production operations support needs.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Inpria offers competitive compensation including a bonus and an excellent benefits package:

* Relocation assistance is available.
* Group health, dental, and vision insurance with family coverage.
* Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability paid for 100% by Inpria.
* 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.
* Thirteen (13) Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

**About Inpria:**

Inpria Corporation is the world leader in metal oxide photoresist design, development, and manufacturing. Inpria’s EUV photoresists enable semiconductor manufacturers to realize the full potential of EUV lithography.

Nestled against the foothills of the coast range, Corvallis, OR is consistently ranked among the country's most livable and family-friendly towns, offering excellent outdoor recreation activities in the nearby Cascade Mountains and Oregon coast.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Inpria is an equal-opportunity employer. At Inpria, we recognize that diversity of thought enhances innovation and problem-solving. Inpria is dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment where employees feel respected, valued, and empowered. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives, and cultural backgrounds each employee brings to our workplace.

Learn more at www.inpria.com
